superseded_observation.correction: The earlier failure was not a stalling Docker CLI. Harbor 0.21.0 (the global uv tool) has no _enable_environment_dir_upload attribute, so HostIsolatedDockerEnvironment.start() raised AttributeError for every separate-verifier task. Installing the locked laminar extra into this worktree's .venv put Harbor 0.24.0 first on PATH under `uv run`; the same commands then ran with no preflight change.
